scope: Native EventLoop consumes a synthetic enqueued request in Unicorn, with host intervention; no concurrent scheduling, Matrix4, GPU paint, saved page or device behavior.
limitations: Queue links are transplanted from the synthetic submission object into native singleton globals. Lock and condition operations and request destructor are host callbacks; execution stops at the loop back-edge. Bitmap, graphics, context, allocation and reference adapters are synthetic. Host runtime and transitive harness dependencies are not fully pinned.
